# Shared Coding Standards

> **DO NOT EDIT FILES IN THIS DIRECTORY DIRECTLY.**
>
> These instruction files are owned by the [ai_gnan_bandar](https://github.com/ramalingesha/ai_gnan_bandar) repo
> and synced here automatically via `scripts/sync-instructions.sh`.
>
> To propose a change:
> 1. Open a PR against `ai_gnan_bandar/.github/instructions/<file>.instructions.md`
> 2. After merge, run `./scripts/sync-instructions.sh` from the workspace root
> 3. Commit the updated files in each affected service repo
